# What does this PR do ?

Migrate Qwen3.5 text and vision-language models to `HybridModel`, preserving HF checkpoint conversion, MTP, and pipeline parallelism. Fix rotary inputs for CUDA graph replay and add regression coverage and a model verification card.

Validated 100-step training and checkpoint resume; step-51 losses match, and step-100 losses differ by 0.057%.

# Changelog

- Add specific line by line info of high level changes in this PR.

If you haven't finished some of the above items you can still open "Draft" PR.

I found two correctness regressions in language-only model construction: virtual-pipeline stage flags are no longer derived correctly, and vocabulary padding is skipped. The new documentation page also needs Fern navigation registration.

The review covered all changed files and their directly affected construction, conversion, checkpoint, and validation paths. This was static inspection; I couldn't execute tests. The Megatron-LM submodule is empty in the supplied tree, so upstream-facing checks relied on available Bridge callers and regression tests.

### Suggested test cases
- `test_provide_language_model_derives_virtual_stage_flags` — proposed; verify both providers across PP=2/VPP=2 and preserve explicit overrides.
- `test_provide_language_model_honors_vocab_padding_policy` — proposed; verify padded, unpadded, and already-aligned vocabularies for both providers.
- `test_language_model_spec_shape` — retain the reusable MIMO spec's raw vocabulary and absence of stage/process-group arguments.
- `test_text_builder_assigns_all_virtual_pipeline_stages` — retain stage offsets, preprocessing/postprocessing flags, and caller-config immutability.
- `test_gpt_checkpoint_rewrite_preserves_other_decoders` — retain language-only key rewriting and unchanged vision keys.
- `test_hybrid_graph_replay_preserves_mtp_fp8_gradients` — verify finite, nonzero MTP gradients and eager/replay agreement.
- `test_hybrid_vl_mtp_preserves_gpt_training[bf16]` — verify matching logits, losses, gradients, and updates.
- `test_hybrid_vl_mtp_preserves_gpt_training[fp8mx]` — verify the same parity assertions with MXFP8 compute.

[P2] Restore virtual-stage checks in language-only construction

**Failure:** With PP=2/VPP=2, calling either provider's `provide_language_model(vp_stage=1)` on PP rank 0 now passes `pre_process=True`. PP rank 1 at `vp_stage=0` similarly receives `post_process=True`. That places embedding/output processing on intermediate logical stages. The [previous implementation](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/32d7094ed873ba8fbba2f2a34088acb1bdce7ffa/src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen_vl/qwen35_vl_provider.py#L544-L546) delegated to GPTModelProvider, whose [stage logic](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/gpt_provider.py#L281-L289) combines physical and virtual predicates.

**Correction:** Import `is_vp_first_stage` and `is_vp_last_stage`, set `vp_size = provider.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size` in `_provide_qwen35_language_model`, and replace the two flag expressions with:

```python
pre_process=(
    is_vp_first_stage(vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size)
    and is_pp_first_stage(pg.pp)
) if pre_process is None else pre_process,
post_process=(
    is_vp_last_stage(vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size)
    and is_pp_last_stage(pg.pp)
) if post_process is None else post_process,
```

Only the first logical stage should preprocess, and only the last should postprocess. Preserve explicit caller flags and non-virtual PP behavior. Keep stage arguments out of the reusable MIMO spec, whose [existing test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/tests/unit_tests/models/megatron_mimo/test_qwen35_vl_provider.py#L54-L79) requires their absence.

**Acceptance — proposed, not run:** Record `build_module` arguments for both providers with PP=2/VPP=2. For `(pp_rank,vp_stage)` values `(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)`, assert `(pre_process,post_process)` equals `(True,False),(False,False),(False,False),(False,True)`. Also check explicit overrides remain unchanged and PP=1 without VPP defaults to `(True,True)`. Verify the suggested code before adopting it.

[P2] Apply vocabulary padding before constructing the language-only model

**Failure:** This path now constructs the reusable MIMO spec directly, whose [vocab_size is the raw provider value](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen_vl/qwen35_vl_provider.py#L578-L595). Both providers consequently ignore `should_pad_vocab=True`. For example, `vocab_size=131`, TP=2, and `make_vocab_size_divisible_by=128` forwards 131 instead of 256, leaving an indivisible vocabulary for tensor-parallel embeddings/output. The former [GPT provider path](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/gpt_provider.py#L265-L271) and the [full VL constructor](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen_vl/modelling_qwen3_vl/model.py#L382-L398) both apply that policy.

**Correction:** Import `calculate_padded_vocab_size` from `megatron.bridge.utils.vocab_utils`. In `_provide_qwen35_language_model`, prepare the fresh spec before `build_module`:

```python
spec = provider.build_language_model_spec()
if provider.should_pad_vocab:
    spec.params["vocab_size"] = calculate_padded_vocab_size(
        provider.vocab_size,
        provider.make_vocab_size_divisible_by,
        provider.tensor_model_parallel_size,
    )
```

Pass `spec` instead of `provider.build_language_model_spec()` to `build_module`. Keep this adjustment local to this construction entry point: preserve the raw-vocabulary contract of `build_language_model_spec()` for MIMO callers. Padding-disabled sizes must remain exact, and already-aligned sizes must remain unchanged.

**Acceptance — proposed, not run:** For both providers, inspect the spec supplied to `build_module`: `131/TP2/divisor128/padding=True` must supply 256; `256/TP2/padding=True` must remain 256; and `131/TP1/padding=False` must remain 131. Separately retain the raw `provider.vocab_size` assertion in [test_language_model_spec_shape](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/tests/unit_tests/models/megatron_mimo/test_qwen35_vl_provider.py#L64-L79). A tiny two-rank model should construct successfully for the padded case. Verify the suggested code before adopting it.

[P2] Register the new Qwen3.5 guide in Fern navigation

**Failure:** The supported-model inventory now links to the new Qwen3.5 guide, but the Qwen section in [nightly.yml](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/docs/fern/versions/nightly.yml#L140-L167) never references its MDX file. The Fern publication workflow [generates directly from that configuration](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/.github/workflows/publish-fern-docs.yml#L84-L90), so adding the file and inventory link alone doesn't register the destination page. The catalog generator also [leaves navigation unchanged when its generated marker is absent](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/scripts/docs/generate_model_verification_catalog.py#L907-L915).

**Correction:** Add this entry to the Qwen `contents` list in `docs/fern/versions/nightly.yml`, next to Qwen3.6:

```yaml
    - page: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
      path: ./nightly/pages/models/qwen/qwen3.5-35b-a3b.mdx
```

Preserve the neighboring Qwen3.6/Qwen3.8 entries, the new page's `verified-qwen3.5-35b-a3b` anchor, and its unverified status; this only needs page registration, not a catalog rewrite.

**Acceptance — proposed, not run:** Confirm the navigation contains exactly one reference to the new MDX file. Generate the Fern site and verify that the inventory link opens the Qwen3.5 page at its verification anchor while the neighboring model links still resolve.

Do we need another bridge base class here? Could we share this logic through helpers and keep the usual bridge hooks?

The part I find confusing is that text configs count `2N` Hybrid positions, while VL keeps `N` HF blocks and expands them later in the constructor. Could both use the same Hybrid config path? That would also simplify the pipeline handling. We'd still need to preserve the HF layer count and attention schedule when exporting.

The `qwen` and `qwen_vl` folders seem to have separate jobs already; it's the two config paths I'd like to simplify.

# What does this PR do ?

Migrate Qwen3.5 text and vision-language models to `HybridModel`, preserving HF checkpoint conversion, MTP, and pipeline parallelism. Fix rotary inputs for CUDA graph replay and add regression coverage and a model verification card.

Validated 100-step training and checkpoint resume; step-51 losses match, and step-100 losses differ by 0.057%.

+"""Qwen3.5 composition of Core's separate attention and feed-forward layers."""
+
+from copy import copy, deepcopy
+from typing import Any
+
+from megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine_spec_provider import TESpecProvider
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_layer_specs import hybrid_stack_spec
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import LayerType
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block import get_num_layers_to_build
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import TransformerLayer
+from transformers import PretrainedConfig
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.param_mapping import MegatronParamMapping
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.transformers_compat import full_attention_interval_from_hf
+
+
+class Qwen35HybridAttentionLayer(TransformerLayer):
+    """Keep TE's class-level graph wrappers separate from the MoE/MLP subclasses.
+
+    Capturing TransformerLayer and its subclasses together can retain an
+    inherited autocast wrapper on uncaptured MTP layers after graph creation.
+    A sibling attention class preserves those layers' quantization contexts.
+    """
+
+
+def qwen35_pipeline_pattern(config: TransformerConfig, pattern: str) -> str:
+    """Assign Hybrid positions to PP/VPP stages without splitting HF blocks."""
+    pp_size = config.pipeline_model_parallel_size
+    vp_size = config.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size
+    if pp_size * (vp_size or 1) == 1:
+        return pattern
+
+    layout = config.pipeline_model_parallel_layout
+    segments, offset = [], 0
+    # Hybrid orders segments by vp_stage * pp_size + pp_rank, just like GPT.
+    for vp_stage in range(vp_size or 1):
+        for pp_rank in range(pp_size):
+            if layout is not None:
+                count = layout.layout[pp_rank][vp_stage].count(LayerType.decoder)
+            else:
+                count = get_num_layers_to_build(config, vp_stage if vp_size else None, pp_rank)
+            width = count
+            if width % 2:
+                raise ValueError("Qwen3.5 pipeline stages must contain whole mixer/feed-forward pairs.")
+            segments.append(pattern[offset : offset + width])
+            offset += width
+    if offset != len(pattern):
+        raise ValueError(f"Pipeline stages hold {offset} Hybrid positions, but the model has {len(pattern)}.")
+    return "|".join(segments)
+
+
+def qwen35_hybrid_pattern(text_config: PretrainedConfig) -> str:
+    """Expand each HF block into a GDN/attention position followed by its MLP."""
+    count = text_config.num_hidden_layers
+    schedule = full_attention_interval_from_hf(text_config)
+    if isinstance(schedule, int):
+        if schedule < 1:
+            raise ValueError("full_attention_interval must be positive.")
+        schedule = [int((index + 1) % schedule != 0) for index in range(count)]
+    if len(schedule) != count:
+        raise ValueError("The attention schedule must contain one entry per HF layer.")
+
+    feed_forward = "E" if getattr(text_config, "num_experts", 0) else "-"
+    return "".join(("G" if linear else "*") + feed_forward for linear in schedule)
+
+
+def qwen35_hybrid_stack_spec() -> ModuleSpec:
+    """Keep Core's GDN and MLP kernels while enabling Qwen's per-head Q/K norms."""
+    spec = deepcopy(hybrid_stack_spec)
+    spec.submodules.gdn_layer.module = Qwen35HybridAttentionLayer
+    spec.submodules.attention_layer.module = Qwen35HybridAttentionLayer
+    attention = spec.submodules.attention_layer.submodules.self_attention.submodules
+    attention.q_layernorm = TESpecProvider().layer_norm(for_qk=True)
+    attention.k_layernorm = TESpecProvider().layer_norm(for_qk=True)
+    return spec
+
+
+def configure_qwen35_hybrid(config_kwargs: dict[str, Any], text_config: PretrainedConfig) -> None:
+    """Convert the language configuration from HF block coordinates to Hybrid positions."""
+    pattern = qwen35_hybrid_pattern(text_config)
+    config_kwargs.update(
+        num_layers=len(pattern),
+        hybrid_layer_pattern=pattern,
+        hybrid_stack_spec=qwen35_hybrid_stack_spec,
+        is_hybrid_model=True,
+        linear_attention_freq=[int(symbol == "G") for symbol in pattern],
+        moe_layer_freq=[int(symbol == "E") for symbol in pattern],
+        mtp_hybrid_override_pattern="*E" if "E" in pattern else "*-",
+    )
+    config_kwargs.pop("rope_scaling", None)
+    config_kwargs.pop("rope_scaling_factor", None)
+
+
+def qwen35_hf_layer_config(pattern: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Recover HF block counts and attention order from a finalized Hybrid pattern."""
+    main_pattern = pattern.split("/")[0].replace("|", "")
+    return {
+        "num_hidden_layers": len(main_pattern) // 2,
+        "layer_types": ["linear_attention" if symbol == "G" else "full_attention" for symbol in main_pattern[::2]],
+    }
+
+
+def qwen35_hybrid_mappings(mappings: list[MegatronParamMapping], *, num_layers: int) -> list[MegatronParamMapping]:
+    """Translate GPT block templates to split Hybrid positions, retaining expert wildcards."""
+    result = []
+    for mapping in mappings:
+        name = mapping.megatron_param
+        if "decoder.layers.*." not in name:
+            renamed = copy(mapping)
+            renamed.megatron_param = name.replace("decoder.final_layernorm.", "decoder.final_norm.")
+            for attribute in ("mtp_model_layer", "transformer_layer"):
+                marker = f".{attribute}."
+                if marker in renamed.megatron_param:
+                    suffix = renamed.megatron_param.split(marker, 1)[1]
+                    inner = int(suffix.startswith(("mlp.", "pre_mlp_layernorm.")))
+                    renamed.megatron_param = renamed.megatron_param.replace(marker, f".{attribute}.layers.{inner}.")
+            result.append(renamed.resolve(tuple("*" for _ in range(renamed.megatron_param.count("*")))))
+            continue
+
+        suffix = name.split("decoder.layers.*.", 1)[1]
+        inner = int(suffix.startswith(("mlp.", "pre_mlp_layernorm.")))
+        for block in range(num_layers):
+            renamed = copy(mapping)
+            renamed.megatron_param = name.replace("decoder.layers.*.", f"decoder.layers.{2 * block + inner}.")
+
+            def replace_hf_layer(value: str) -> str:
+                return value.replace("layers.*.", f"layers.{block}.", 1)
+
+            if isinstance(mapping.hf_param, dict):
+                renamed.hf_param = {key: replace_hf_layer(value) for key, value in mapping.hf_param.items()}
+            else:
+                renamed.hf_param = replace_hf_layer(mapping.hf_param)
+            # Reconstruct through the mapping's own factory to retain layout
+            # options and rebuild nested TP mappings with the new parameter name.
+            result.append(renamed.resolve(tuple("*" for _ in range(renamed.megatron_param.count("*")))))
+    return result

+"""Qwen3.5 text Hybrid construction with explicit pipeline stage boundaries."""
+
+from copy import copy
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import ClassVar
+
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_model import HybridModel
+from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.utils import (
+    is_pp_first_stage,
+    is_pp_last_stage,
+    is_vp_first_stage,
+    is_vp_last_stage,
+)
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.hybrid.hybrid_builder import BridgeHybridModelBuilder
+from megatron.bridge.models.hybrid.model_config import BridgeHybridModelConfig
+from megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen35.hybrid import qwen35_pipeline_pattern
+
+
+@dataclass(kw_only=True)
+class Qwen35HybridModelConfig(BridgeHybridModelConfig):
+    """Language config whose layer counts and pipeline layouts use Hybrid positions."""
+
+    builder: ClassVar[str] = "megatron.bridge.models.qwen.modeling_qwen35.model_config.Qwen35HybridModelBuilder"
+
+
+def prepare_qwen35_pipeline_config(model_config: Qwen35HybridModelConfig) -> Qwen35HybridModelConfig:
+    """Finalize and partition a copy for construction, preserving the caller's config."""
+    config = copy(model_config)
+    config.transformer = copy(config.transformer)
+    config.finalize()
+    main_pattern, separator, mtp_pattern = config.hybrid_layer_pattern.partition("/")
+    if "|" not in main_pattern:
+        main_pattern = qwen35_pipeline_pattern(config.transformer, main_pattern)
+        config.hybrid_layer_pattern = main_pattern + separator + mtp_pattern
+    if "|" in main_pattern:
+        config.num_layers_in_first_pipeline_stage = None
+        config.num_layers_in_last_pipeline_stage = None
+        config.pipeline_model_parallel_layout = None
+    return config
+
+
+class Qwen35HybridModelBuilder(BridgeHybridModelBuilder):
+    """Resolve PP/VPP boundaries after the caller has applied parallelism overrides."""
+
+    def build_model(
+        self,
+        pg_collection: ProcessGroupCollection,
+        pre_process: bool | None = None,
+        post_process: bool | None = None,
+        vp_stage: int | None = None,
+    ) -> HybridModel:
+        """Build a stage without modifying the caller's pattern or pipeline settings."""
+        config = prepare_qwen35_pipeline_config(self._model_config)
+
+        vp_size = config.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size
+        if pre_process is None:
+            pre_process = is_vp_first_stage(vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size) and is_pp_first_stage(pg_collection.pp)
+        if post_process is None:
+            post_process = is_vp_last_stage(vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size) and is_pp_last_stage(pg_collection.pp)
+
+        return BridgeHybridModelBuilder(config).build_model(pg_collection, pre_process, post_process, vp_stage)

+from contextvars import ContextVar

+
+_POSITION_IDS: ContextVar[torch.Tensor | None] = ContextVar("qwen35_hybrid_position_ids", default=None)
+
+
+class _HybridMultimodalRotaryEmbedding(Qwen3VLMultimodalRotaryEmbedding):
+    def forward(self, max_seq_len: int, *, packed_seq: bool = False) -> torch.Tensor:
+        position_ids = _POSITION_IDS.get()
+        if position_ids is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Qwen3.5 Hybrid mRoPE requires the current forward's position_ids.")
+        return super().forward(position_ids, self.mrope_section)
+
+
+class Qwen35VLHybridAttentionLayer(Qwen3VLRotaryTransformerLayer):
+    """Keep language graph wrappers separate from vision and feed-forward layers."""

+def qwen35_vl_hybrid_stack_spec() -> ModuleSpec:
+    """Use Qwen's absolute multimodal rotary attention in the Hybrid stack."""
+    spec = qwen35_hybrid_stack_spec()
+    spec.submodules.attention_layer.module = Qwen35VLHybridAttentionLayer
+    spec.submodules.attention_layer.submodules.self_attention.module = Qwen3VLSelfAttention
+    return spec
+
+
+class Qwen35VLHybridLanguageModel(HybridModel):
+    """Add multimodal rotary inputs to the already configured Hybrid decoder."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: TransformerConfig,
+        transformer_layer_spec: ModuleSpec,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        max_sequence_length: int,
+        *,
+        rotary_percent: float,
+        rotary_base: int,
+        hybrid_layer_pattern: str,
+        position_embedding_type: str = "mrope",
+        mtp_block_spec: ModuleSpec | None = None,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        if transformer_layer_spec.submodules.attention_layer.module is Qwen35VLHybridAttentionLayer:
+            transformer_layer_spec = deepcopy(transformer_layer_spec)
+            transformer_layer_spec.submodules.attention_layer.params["rotary_dim"] = int(
+                config.kv_channels * rotary_percent
+            )
+
+        super().__init__(
+            config=config,
+            hybrid_stack_spec=transformer_layer_spec,
+            hybrid_layer_pattern=hybrid_layer_pattern,
+            vocab_size=vocab_size,
+            max_sequence_length=max_sequence_length,
+            position_embedding_type="rope",
+            rotary_percent=rotary_percent,
+            rotary_base=rotary_base,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+        self.rotary_pos_emb = _HybridMultimodalRotaryEmbedding(
+            kv_channels=config.kv_channels,
+            rotary_percent=rotary_percent,
+            rotary_interleaved=config.rotary_interleaved,
+            rotary_base=rotary_base,
+            seq_len_interpolation_factor=kwargs.get("seq_len_interpolation_factor"),
+            cp_group=self.pg_collection.cp,
+        )
+        self.rotary_pos_emb.mrope_section = config.mrope_section
+
+        if self.mtp_process:
+            self.mtp.register_forward_pre_hook(self._mtp_token_embedding_inputs, with_kwargs=True)
+
+    def tie_embeddings_and_output_weights_state_dict(
+        self,
+        sharded_state_dict: ShardedStateDict,
+        output_layer_weight_key: str,
+        first_stage_word_emb_key: str,
+        metadata: dict | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Store tied MTP weights only in the embedding entry on the last stage."""
+        if self.mtp_process and not self.pre_process:
+            sharded_state_dict.pop(output_layer_weight_key, None)
+
+        super().tie_embeddings_and_output_weights_state_dict(
+            sharded_state_dict,
+            output_layer_weight_key,
+            first_stage_word_emb_key,
+            metadata if metadata is not None else {},
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _mtp_token_embedding_inputs(
+        _module: torch.nn.Module, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any]
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[Any, ...], dict[str, Any]]:
+        # The GPT VLM conditions MTP on shifted token embeddings. HybridModel
+        # otherwise reuses the composed vision-language embeddings, changing
+        # image positions and boundary values used by the MoE auxiliary loss.
+        kwargs["decoder_input"] = None
+        return args, kwargs
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        position_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None,
+        *,
+        visual_pos_masks: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        deepstack_visual_embeds: list[torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Pass explicit multimodal positions to Core's rotary preparation and MTP path."""
+        if deepstack_visual_embeds:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen3.5 does not use DeepStack visual embeddings.")
+        token = _POSITION_IDS.set(position_ids)
+        try:
+            return super().forward(input_ids, position_ids, attention_mask, **kwargs)
+        finally:
+            _POSITION_IDS.reset(token)
+
+

+
+    language_model_class = Qwen35VLHybridLanguageModel
+

+        super()._expose_language_model_for_cuda_graph_helper()
+        self.position_embedding_type = "mrope"
+
+

+        super()._expose_language_model_for_cuda_graph_helper()
+        self.position_embedding_type = "mrope"

+"""Explicit rotary inputs for Qwen vision-language CUDA graphs."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core.transformer.enums import CudaGraphModule
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import TransformerLayer, TransformerLayerSubmodules
+
+
+class Qwen3VLRotaryTransformerLayer(TransformerLayer):
+    """Declare Qwen's batch-dependent rotary input before any forward runs.
+
+    Use separate language and vision subclasses so TE's class-level capture
+    wrappers do not propagate between independently captured stacks.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: TransformerConfig,
+        submodules: TransformerLayerSubmodules,
+        *,
+        rotary_dim: int,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        if rotary_dim <= 0 or rotary_dim % 2:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen rotary_dim must be a positive even number.")
+        super().__init__(config=config, submodules=submodules, **kwargs)
+        self.rotary_dim = rotary_dim
+
+    def get_layer_static_inputs(self, seq_length: int, micro_batch_size: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Reserve an FP32 rotary input that TE updates on every replay."""
+        inputs = super().get_layer_static_inputs(seq_length, micro_batch_size)
+        if self.config.cuda_graph_modules and CudaGraphModule.attn not in self.config.cuda_graph_modules:
+            return inputs
+
+        if getattr(self.config, "sequence_packing_scheduler", None) is not None:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen rotary CUDA graph inputs require a fixed sequence layout.")
+        cp_size = self.config.context_parallel_size
+        if seq_length % cp_size:
+            raise ValueError("Qwen rotary CUDA graph sequence length must be divisible by context parallel size.")
+
+        # Attention gathers sequence-parallel tokens before applying RoPE, so
+        # its sequence axis is partitioned by CP but not by TP.
+        inputs["rotary_pos_emb"] = torch.zeros(
+            (seq_length // cp_size, micro_batch_size, 1, self.rotary_dim),
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=inputs["hidden_states"].device,
+        )
+        return inputs

+            model.zero_grad_buffer()

[P2] Restore virtual-stage checks in language-only construction

**Failure:** With PP=2/VPP=2, calling either provider's `provide_language_model(vp_stage=1)` on PP rank 0 now passes `pre_process=True`. PP rank 1 at `vp_stage=0` similarly receives `post_process=True`. That places embedding/output processing on intermediate logical stages. The [previous implementation](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/32d7094ed873ba8fbba2f2a34088acb1bdce7ffa/src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen_vl/qwen35_vl_provider.py#L544-L546) delegated to GPTModelProvider, whose [stage logic](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/gpt_provider.py#L281-L289) combines physical and virtual predicates.

**Correction:** Import `is_vp_first_stage` and `is_vp_last_stage`, set `vp_size = provider.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size` in `_provide_qwen35_language_model`, and replace the two flag expressions with:

```python
pre_process=(
    is_vp_first_stage(vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size)
    and is_pp_first_stage(pg.pp)
) if pre_process is None else pre_process,
post_process=(
    is_vp_last_stage(vp_stage=vp_stage, vp_size=vp_size)
    and is_pp_last_stage(pg.pp)
) if post_process is None else post_process,
```

Only the first logical stage should preprocess, and only the last should postprocess. Preserve explicit caller flags and non-virtual PP behavior. Keep stage arguments out of the reusable MIMO spec, whose [existing test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/tests/unit_tests/models/megatron_mimo/test_qwen35_vl_provider.py#L54-L79) requires their absence.

**Acceptance — proposed, not run:** Record `build_module` arguments for both providers with PP=2/VPP=2. For `(pp_rank,vp_stage)` values `(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)`, assert `(pre_process,post_process)` equals `(True,False),(False,False),(False,False),(False,True)`. Also check explicit overrides remain unchanged and PP=1 without VPP defaults to `(True,True)`. Verify the suggested code before adopting it.

[P2] Apply vocabulary padding before constructing the language-only model

**Failure:** This path now constructs the reusable MIMO spec directly, whose [vocab_size is the raw provider value](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen_vl/qwen35_vl_provider.py#L578-L595). Both providers consequently ignore `should_pad_vocab=True`. For example, `vocab_size=131`, TP=2, and `make_vocab_size_divisible_by=128` forwards 131 instead of 256, leaving an indivisible vocabulary for tensor-parallel embeddings/output. The former [GPT provider path](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/gpt_provider.py#L265-L271) and the [full VL constructor](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/6452af72ace14f5ba28f54e6373792d8bbd022ee/src/megatron/bridge/models/qwen_vl/modelling_qwen3_vl/model.py#L382-L398) both apply that policy.

**Correction:** Import `calculate_padded_vocab_size` from `megatron.bridge.utils.vocab_utils`. In `_provide_qwen35_language_model`, prepare the fresh spec before `build_module`:

```python
spec = provider.build_language_model_spec()
if provider.should_pad_vocab:
    spec.params["vocab_size"] = calculate_padded_vocab_size(
```

+                for name, grad in grads.items():
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(grad, reference_grads[name], rtol=2e-2, atol=2e-4)
+            del loss
+    finally:
+        if helper.graphs_created():
+            helper.delete_cuda_graphs()
+
+
+class _GPTQwen35ReferenceBridge(Qwen35MoEBridge):
